commands.name: help
commands.description: List available commands or explain one registered command.
commands.certification_implications: None; command discovery produces no certification evidence.

commands.name: version
commands.description: Print the Fortress CLI implementation version.
commands.certification_implications: None; implementation identity output is not certification evidence.

commands.name: audit
commands.description: Build and evaluate a stabilized repository snapshot.
commands.certification_implications: Produces deterministic development audit evidence only; it is not Fortress certification.

commands.name: ccg
commands.description: Compile and render the deterministic Contract Coherency Graph.
commands.certification_implications: Renders derived semantic intent and coherency only; it is not certification evidence.

commands.name: bfg
commands.description: Compile and render the deterministic Intended Behavioral Flow Graph.
commands.certification_implications: Renders intended Feature behavior only; it is not implementation realization or certification evidence.

commands.name: psm
commands.description: Compile and render the deterministic Program Semantic Model.
commands.certification_implications: Renders observed executable structure only; it is not behavioral realization, function correctness, or certification evidence.

commands.name: semantic
commands.description: Compile and render deterministic function-domain analysis.
commands.certification_implications: Renders supported abstract-domain consequences and explicit uncertainty only; it is not total program safety or certification evidence.

commands.name: state-effect
commands.description: Compile and render deterministic state and effect analysis.
commands.certification_implications: Renders supported typestate and effect consequences plus explicit uncertainty only; it is not total heap safety, external-system proof, or certification evidence.

commands.name: information-flow
commands.description: Compile and render deterministic information-flow analysis.
commands.certification_implications: Renders supported trust/confidentiality propagation, sink contradictions, trusted transitions, and explicit uncertainty only; it is not comprehensive security proof or certification evidence.
